name: validate_prow_job_runs_missing_from_old
description: Count prow_job_runs rows from the old table that are missing from the partitioned production table for the last 120 days. Returns only days with missing rows.
query: SELECT DATE(o.timestamp) AS day, COUNT(*) AS missing_count FROM prow_job_runs_old o LEFT JOIN prow_job_runs n ON o.id = n.id AND o.prow_job_release = n.prow_job_release AND o.timestamp = n.timestamp WHERE o.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' AND n.id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
